instructions: You are one of two independent readers for a public record that scores theories of consciousness. A prediction counts for a study if the theory's proponents fixed it before they could have known the study's result: before the study's registration, for a study registered before its data were collected; before its earliest public appearance (preprint or publication), for any other study; before the data first appeared, for a study reanalysing earlier published data. A paper that states a prediction and tests it in the same paper does not count. When the dates or the commitment are unclear, the study is not counted. Read the passages and the dates, and decide whether the earlier record, by the theory's proponents, commits the theory to the prediction as the study tests it, in time. Decide: BEFORE, NOT-BEFORE, or UNCLEAR. Answer in JSON: {"verdict": "before"|"not-before"|"unclear", "reason": "two to four plain sentences", "unsure": true|false, "unsure_why": "..."}.

core_claim.quote: In the attention schema theory, awareness is part of the control machinery for attention.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.statement: Without awareness of an item, attention can still be drawn to it, but the brain's deliberate control of that attention (sustaining it, suppressing it, shifting it away) is impaired.

first_stated.passage: If awareness is an internal model of attention and is used to help control attention, then without awareness, attention should still be possible but it should suffer deficits in control.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.test_for: With a stimulus made unreportable (for example by masking) while it still measurably draws attention, people cannot deliberately sustain, suppress or redirect attention with respect to it, although they can when they are aware of it.
prediction.test_against: With the stimulus unreportable and still drawing attention, deliberate control of attention with respect to it is as good as when people are aware of it.

source.citation: Wang H, Yang J, Gao Y, Zhang M. Subliminal meaning-contingent attentional orienting: The role of attentional control setting based on displaywide features. Frontiers in Psychology 13:1035690, 2022

passages.text: Just so, in the attention schema theory, if the brain is allocating attention to item X but unaware of X, it has made an error in its internal model of attention, failing to register that its attention has been perturbed by X. In that case, the top–down control of attention should be compromised.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

passages.text: Regardless of the informational domain, the general prediction is the same: without awareness, attention should still be possible but should suffer a deficit in control.
